files.document_title: Texas Gateway Project map, Gulf South Pipeline, February 2026
files.what_it_shows: The project as a green line from the Carthage station in Texas, south through the Magasco station, then southeast across the Sabine River to Gillis, Louisiana. Drawn on a county and parish base with a 60 mile scale bar.
Page 1 rendered at 150 dpi. Small scale regional map, so it locates the line only loosely.

searched: The oilandgaswatch record and its attached documents.
notes: The oilandgaswatch record page is a JavaScript application shell, so the URL checker cannot read it. The geometry comes from the site's data record, which was saved in fetched_layers/ogw. The oilandgaswatch geometry is graded Medium by that site. The PDF has no text layer, so the URL checker cannot read words from it. It loads with status 200 and the map is a picture.
